description: Ireland's Health Service Executive (HSE) has approved capecitabine as available to patients within the public health system as a monotherapy treatment option for the adjuvant treatment of patients with stage I to IIIB triple negative breast cancer (TNBC) with residual invasive disease after neoadjuvant chemotherapy treatment.

contributions.description: HSE approval date set to the version 6 date (2022-08-24): the indication is present on 2023-01-17 in version 6 of the treatment regimen (https://web.archive.org/web/20230117010954/https://www.hse.ie/eng/services/list/5/cancer/profinfo/chemoprotocols/breast/216.pdf) but not in the version 5 on 2022-07-02 (https://web.archive.org/web/20220702145108/https://www.hse.ie/eng/services/list/5/cancer/profinfo/chemoprotocols/breast/216.pdf).
